request.summary: Review why successful Task Session runs repeatedly require a separate Refresh apply roundtrip.
request.intent: Make bounded evidence and status synchronization part of Task Session closeout without absorbing the next task or another owner's mutation.

execution.notes: The observed behavior follows the current contracts: Task Session can finish execution before planning projections are synchronized, while Invoke Refresh requires a separate apply-approved route.

anti_pattern_hits: a successful task returned a separate proposal-only Refresh approval request for deterministic closeout bookkeeping
closeout synchronization was treated as optional continuation instead of part of the task lifecycle

workflow_gaps.summary: Task Session does not automatically join the owner receipt that synchronizes evidence-backed task, work-pack, route, and projection state after successful execution.
workflow_gaps.evidence: The live Task Session contract makes continuation optional, while the current passing execution example ends at a proposal-only Invoke Refresh with apply authorization still open.
